title: Indices and surds
summary: Index notation, the index laws, zero and negative indices, scientific notation, fractional indices and simple surds.

cards.title: Index notation
cards.rule: \(2^5\): 2 is the base, 5 is the index (how many 2s multiply).

cards.title: Multiplying and dividing
cards.rule: Same base: multiply, add the indices. Divide, subtract them.

cards.title: Power of a power, zero index
cards.rule: Power of a power: multiply the indices. Anything to the power 0 is 1.

cards.title: Brackets and fractions
cards.rule: The power applies to everything inside the brackets.

cards.title: Negative indices
cards.rule: A negative index means one over: \(a^{-n} = \dfrac{1}{a^n}\).

cards.title: Scientific notation
cards.tip: big numbers get a positive power, small ones a negative power.

cards.title: Scientific notation and significant figures
cards.rule: Round the first number to the significant figures asked for.

cards.title: Fractional indices and surds
cards.rule: \(a^{\frac12} = \sqrt a\), \(a^{\frac13} = \sqrt[3]{a}\). A surd is a root that isn't a whole number, like \(\sqrt2\).

cards.title: Simple operations with surds
cards.rule: Add or subtract like surds only. Multiply: multiply the numbers outside and inside.
